newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks soften in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks soften in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks softened early in the Tuesday morning trading session, as investors, just back from a three-day weekend, held to the sidelines to await the U.S. Federal Reserve chairman's testimony later in the day, brokers said.
They said high-tech stocks propping up the market in recent sessions were weakening in the wake of Wall Street, which is showing signs of entering an adjustment phase.
As of 0012 GMT the Nikkei 225 was down 6.90 points or 0.03 percent at 20,242.42. September Nikkei futures were down 10 at 20,270.
